# HEM v0.6.2b5 — Optional connected-room starts and measured energy

Retains the v0.6.2b4 Reading availability startup fix. Announcement Hub routing is unchanged and out of scope.

## Optional start coordination
- Each selected door has a Device start coordination selector: Observe only (default), Delay conflicting starts, or Coordinate starts.
- Applies only to new Automatic starts across explicit direct interior connections. Contact health, effective Area, a 30-second stable open state, peer permissions, confirmed native activity and HEM power ownership are rechecked at dispatch.
- Heating/cooling and humidifying/drying conflicts may briefly defer a start. Coordinate starts also considers an already-running same-purpose heater, cooler, humidifier/dehumidifier or explicitly configured particle filter, only with a favourable fresh measured gradient.
- A shared-output wait requires measurable progress after 60 seconds and never exceeds its original 180-second budget. Door flapping, peer changes, reconnects and missing evidence cannot renew it. Normal controller evaluation still determines when a command is appropriate.
- No new device grants, peer starts, forced stops, target changes, PID changes or door/lock commands. Manual/preset/PID, sleep, Away, arrival and urgent local/mould demand bypass this optional layer. Generic fans, extraction/CO2 ventilation and ambiguous AUTO directions are excluded.

## Measured energy, not claimed savings
- Optional same-Area native cumulative energy meter (Wh/kWh/MWh; total or total_increasing).
- Room information and diagnostics show observed kWh, covered minutes, mean measured watts and excluded intervals, split by door-open and door-closed state.
- Repeated unchanged samples, gaps, observed resets, changed units, missing/restored sources, implausible jumps and door transitions are not interpolated. Source changes reset the session comparison. At least 15 observed minutes in each state are needed for the coverage flag; this is not statistical proof of savings.
- Session-only bounded memory; no new poller, recorder queries or storage migration. Comparisons sharing the same meter are independent and must not be added together.

## Interface and verification
- Windows → Door contacts → Eco → Shades remains unchanged; per-contact controls remain in the same submenu.
- English, Greek and German controls/help. Mobile/desktop popup and exact-entity write tests retain the b2 prefix cleanup and b4 startup regression coverage.
- New deterministic budget, engine, real dispatch-race and measured-energy tests are included in CI.

Install through HACS and restart Home Assistant to load backend changes, then reload the dashboard. No server installation, restart or appliance commands are performed by the release process.
